integrity: Complete self-contained proof, explicit coefficient formula, graph-distance exhaustive verifier and full reproducibility output are provided. Finite checks do not replace the general proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers only a matching of size \(1\le t<\min\{a,b\}\) deleted from \(K_{a,b}\) with \(a,b\ge3\). It does not cover arbitrary deletions or other visibility variants. The crown-graph boundary \(t=a=b\) and undeleted \(t=0\) cases have prior literature. An unrestricted originality guarantee is unavailable; independent validation has not been performed.
title: Mutual-visibility set enumerator of complete bipartite graphs with a deleted matching
